title: Wake path
summary: A case's wake_path is automatic (default: starts when its stage begins, and the stage driver wakes the member's owner) or manual (starts only when steering wakes the owner). Manual needs a one-line wake_evidence naming real-traffic evidence a registered read can confirm; authoring refuses wake_evidence_required, wake_evidence_without_manual_wake, wake_path_invalid or wake_evidence_not_one_line. The stage driver leaves a member with an open manual case unwoken, so its whole roster waits; the steering fleet report lists each under 'waiting on manual wake' with evidence, owner and the yoke say --item wake. A live requirement is marked with yoke qa requirement update, wake_evidence first, then wake_path.
